Spiritual Gorillaz modification: namespace declarations and imports were relocated
from MaxMind\Db to Spirit\ThirdParty\MaxMind\Db. This isolates the bundled bounded
PHP decoder from older optional host extensions. Decoding behavior is unchanged.
Only five runtime PHP source files are included; no Composer or host-side build is
needed, and the extension is not used by this feature.
